description: This file defines a feature in a C# ASP.NET Core project for listing articles. It includes a query object, a handler class that processes the list request with filtering options based on tags, authors, favorites, and user feed status, and returns a collection of articles encapsulated in an envelope.

classes.name: List
classes.description: A class encapsulating the article listing feature with a nested Query record and a QueryHandler class implementing request handling logic.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Asynchronous method that processes the query to retrieve articles based on filters like tag, author, favorited username, and user feed, returning a collection of articles.
